verdict.rationale: Entra's own documentation says Microsoft Entra Domain Services offers managed LDAP and Kerberos/NTLM authentication for legacy applications that cannot use modern authentication, which covers the cloud-LDAP half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a RADIUS endpoint or support for VPN or Wi-Fi authentication. Domain Services is also a companion service within the Entra family rather than core Entra ID. Missing for 10: cloud RADIUS endpoint, documented VPN/Wi-Fi (802.1X) authentication, setup depth for LDAP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, legacy protocols still work — cloud LDAP and RADIUS endpoints serve the VPNs, Wi-Fi, and older systems that will never speak SAML

citations.quote: Microsoft Entra Domain Services provides managed domain services like group policy, LDAP, and Kerberos/NTLM authentication. It's designed for legacy applications in the cloud that can't use modern authentication methods.
